case_title: Chaitu Gowala And Another v. The State Of Assam
accused_occupation: Office bearers of the labour union
trial_court_outcome: Convicted and sentenced to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused were present at the incident site as office bearers of a labour union. There were disputes regarding wages. The accused entered the office room and then exited, informing the gathered labourers that the Managing Director would distribute their dues. The labourers protested, demanding full dues, and started shouting. Other co-accused snatched the carbine of the PSO. The Managing Director asked the accused why the weapon was snatched. The accused spoke to the labourers in their own language, causing them to become agitated. There is no evidence that the accused caused any injury to the deceased or participated in the commission of the offence.
